summary: Nuveen Churchill Private Capital Income Fund filed an 8-K/A amending its initial report on the completion of its acquisition of substantially all assets of Nuveen Churchill BDC V for $346,954,197, equal to the seller's net asset value as of April 29, 2026, under a Purchase and Sale Agreement dated April 1, 2026. Both boards, including independent trustees, approved the transaction under Rule 17a-8, and BDC V shareholders approved on April 30, 2026. The affiliate deal involved external managers under Nuveen. Regulatory filings include audited financials in an amended 8-K. Watch for post-close integration and any shareholder litigation.
